stem.text: Two coplanar forces act on the rim of a wheel. The forces are equal in magnitude.
Which arrangement of forces provides only a couple?

A.alt: Circular wheel with an upward arrow touching its left side and a horizontal arrow pointing right from its top

B.alt: Circular wheel with a horizontal arrow pointing right from its top and a horizontal arrow pointing right from its bottom

C.alt: Circular wheel with a horizontal arrow pointing right from its top and a downward arrow on its left side

D.alt: Circular wheel with a horizontal arrow pointing right from its top and a horizontal arrow pointing left at its bottom
